title: Correct thickness expression
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (a) must give the thickness as d = d_0 - Q²/(2εAk).

title: Correct voltage expression
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (b) must give the voltage as V = (Q/(εA)) * (d_0 - Q²/(2εAk)).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must equate the electrostatic attraction force (Q²/(2εA)) to the spring restoring force (k(d_0 - d)).

title: Voltage maximization process
description: Important: For part (c), the solution must find dV/dQ = 0 to determine the charge Q_max at which voltage is maximum.

title: Critical spring constant inequality
description: Essential: The final answer for part (c) must be the inequality k > (27/8) * (V_th² ε A / d_0³) or its equivalent.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: For part (d), the work done by pumps must be identified as the sum of spring potential energy and electrostatic energy stored.

title: Correct work for k larger
description: Essential: The answer for part (d)(i) must be W = (5/18) k d_0².

title: Correct work for k smaller
description: Essential: The answer for part (d)(ii) must be W = (1/2) k d_0².

title: Misidentifying electric field
description: Pitfall: Using the parallel-plate capacitor field E=Q/(εA) to calculate the force between the layers, instead of the field from a single sheet.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the force balance (e.g., spring force direction) or in the voltage expression leading to a non-physical thickness.
